description: Exact, auditable exception registry for tooling/security/scan-history-secrets.mjs. An entry exempts ONE historical occurrence of a credential-shaped string in documentation. Every entry binds: the exact introducing commit SHA, the exact repository-relative file path, the diff-line occurrence type (added/removed), and the SHA-256 of the normalized diff-line content. A single differing character, file, commit or op makes the exception inapplicable and the occurrence a hard hit. No entry may exempt future content.
normalization: diff line with the single leading +/- marker removed; CRLF converted to LF; trailing whitespace stripped; UTF-8 bytes hashed with SHA-256
